Vicky Kaushal Attends Taarak Mehta Actor Shailesh Lodha's Daughter's Wedding

Actor Vicky Kaushal was present at the wedding of Shailesh Lodha's daughter, who is known for his role in the show 'Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah'. Kaushal was seen participating in wedding rituals, described as 'ladki wala'. Some reports noted the absence of other actors from the show.
